items.title: Mandatory Jobcenter meeting (Meldeaufforderung)
items.quote: bitte kommen Sie am Mittwoch, 22.04.2026 um 08:15 Uhr in das Jobcenter Musterlingen, Raum 1.18, zu Frau Petzold.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date and time for the appointment (Mittwoch, 22.04.2026, 08:15 Uhr), so no period calculation is required; the due date is simply the printed date. 22.04.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Sachsen, confirming the date is valid as a business day.

warnings: The letter carries a Rechtsfolgenbelehrung (not a formal Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) warning that missing the appointment without an important reason (ohne wichtigen Grund) will reduce Bürgergeld by 10% of the relevant Regelbedarf for one month under §32 SGB II; the person should keep proof of any valid excuse (e.g. illness) and notify the Jobcenter promptly if they cannot attend.
